# watchpoint_cloud_integration (Resource)

A cloud metric integration: AWS CloudWatch, Azure Monitor or GCP Cloud Monitoring metrics for the chosen resource types are pulled every five minutes and stored as OTLP gauges (billed as metric datapoints). At most 10 per tenant. Requires the `cloud_integrations` feature (Pro). Credentials are write-only: they are kept in state from configuration and a change made in the portal is not detected.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Pull CloudWatch metrics for RDS and EC2 by assuming a role that trusts the
# external id watchpoint-<tenant id>.
resource "watchpoint_cloud_integration" "aws_prod" {
  provider_type  = "aws"
  name           = "AWS production"
  resource_types = ["rds", "ec2"]
  regions        = ["us-east-1", "eu-west-1"]
  role_arn       = "arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/watchpoint-metrics"
}

# Azure Monitor through an app registration with Monitoring Reader.
resource "watchpoint_cloud_integration" "azure" {
  provider_type   = "azure"
  resource_types  = ["vm", "sql"]
  directory_id    = var.azure_tenant_id
  client_id       = var.azure_client_id
  client_secret   = var.azure_client_secret
  subscription_id = var.azure_subscription_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `provider_type` (String) `aws`, `azure` or `gcp`. Changing it replaces the integration.
- `resource_types` (Set of String) Resource types to collect, keys from the integration catalog, for example `ec2`, `rds`, `lambda` for AWS. Unknown keys are rejected.

### Optional

- `access_key_id` (String) `aws`: access key id (`AKIA...`). Use either a key or `role_arn`.
- `client_id` (String) `azure`: application (client) id holding Monitoring Reader.
- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) `azure`: client secret.
- `directory_id` (String) `azure`: directory (tenant) id.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the integration is polled. Defaults to `true`.
- `name` (String) Display name (100 characters max). Defaults to the provider in capitals.
- `regions` (Set of String) `aws`: regions to read. Defaults to `us-east-1`.
- `role_arn` (String) `aws`: IAM role to assume, trusted for the external id `watchpoint-<tenant id>`. Only where the platform offers role access.
- `secret_access_key` (String, Sensitive) `aws`: secret access key.
- `service_account_json` (String, Sensitive) `gcp`: service account JSON key with Monitoring Viewer.
- `subscription_id` (String) `azure`: subscription to read.

### Read-Only

- `client_email` (String) `gcp`: service account email read from the key.
- `has_secret` (Boolean) Whether a secret credential is stored.
- `id` (String) Integration ID.
- `project_id` (String) `gcp`: project read from the service account key.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import watchpoint_cloud_integration.aws_prod ci_001
```
